svg.text: On this machine: SHA-256 is 1.28× to 2.14× faster than BLAKE3; BLAKE3 is 1.56× to 3.59× faster than SHA-1DC; BLAKE3 SME2 matches BLAKE3 below 2 KiB and is up to 2.51× faster from there
Line and dot: median · shaded band: minimum–maximum across 120 interleaved samples · single-threaded · lower is better · click a name at right to hide or show that contender
